name: Reviews, Feedback & Reputation
summary: Ask every customer for a review at the right moment, fix problems fast, and watch your reputation.
description: Online reviews drive local buying decisions, and the businesses with the most recent, most numerous reviews tend to win. The hard part is not asking; it is asking every customer, at the right moment, without forgetting. These automations time review requests to the moment of delivery, ask every customer the same way, alert a manager the moment someone reports a problem so it can be fixed fast, and monitor what customers are saying across platforms.
